Nine places to go deeper than this lesson. All were checked and loading (HTTP 200, or the
oEmbed check for the video) at the time this page was written. No CMS or CLIA deemed-status page
is linked: the one page tried returned HTTP 404, and the lesson itself does not teach it.

- **[AABB, "Accreditation Process"](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/accreditation/become-accredited/accreditation-process)**
  — the page this lesson quotes directly: the two-phase self-assessment/on-site structure, APEX,
  the "PPPs are followed as written" expectation, the two-year reassessment cycle, and the
  six-month minimum operating history for a first accreditation. Read it yourself before citing
  any of its wording in a real Lakeshore document.

- **[AABB, "Become Accredited"](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/accreditation/become-accredited)**
  — AABB's own landing page for the accreditation program generally, one level up from the
  process page above. Useful for the broader context of what accreditation covers and why a
  facility pursues it in the first place.

- **[AABB, Updated Quality Systems Essentials](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/standards/about-aabb-standards/updated-quality-systems-essentials)**
  — AABB's own current page on the ten Quality System Essentials (QSEs), including QSE 3
  (Equipment) and QSE 8 (Assessments: Internal and External), the two QSE themes this lesson
  names without quoting any Standards text. Use it to see the theme and scope of each QSE in
  AABB's own words; don't cite a standard number from it.

- **[061CE: Better AABB Assessments with Anne Chenoweth](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5E5_ynnrpqo)**
  (Blood Bank Guy (D. Joe Chaffin MD), from oEmbed `author_name`) — the video embedded in this
  lesson. A 2018 interview with AABB's Director of Accreditation and Quality on practical
  assessment tips and common pitfalls. General, not Lakeshore-specific, and dated, so use it for
  the assessor's point of view, not current procedure. Verified embeddable via YouTube oEmbed on
  2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Blood Bank Guy: episode 061CE page](https://www.bbguy.org/2018/12/12/061/)** — show notes
  for the same interview, useful to see what it covers before you spend the time. Verified loading
  via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Blood Bank Guy: 061CE transcript (PDF)](https://www.bbguy.org/pdf/BBGE_061_Anne-Chenoweth_Transcript.pdf)**
  — a written transcript of the interview, faster to skim than the video if you want to scan for
  a specific assessment pitfall. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[AABB, Accreditation Portal (APEX)](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/accreditation/accreditation-portal)**
  — AABB's own page on APEX, the portal where Lakeshore's QA does the self-assessment this
  lesson describes. Read it to see what the portal is for from AABB's side. Verified loading via
  `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[AABB, advance notification for assessments update](https://www.aabb.org/news-resources/news/article/2025/06/18/aabb-accreditation-announces-update-to-advance-notification-for-assessments)**
  — an AABB news item about how far ahead facilities are told of a scheduled assessment, a
  practical contrast with an unannounced-style FDA visit. Check the page itself for current
  details. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[AABB, "The Importance of AABB Assessors"](https://www.aabb.org/news-resources/news/aabb-news/article/october-2026/the-importance-of-aabb-assessors)**
  — an AABB news profile of the volunteer assessors who carry out on-site assessments, useful for
  understanding who is actually on the other side of the table. Verified loading via `curl` on
  2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

## Keep learning

Not official sources — good places to learn more about preparing for and living through an accreditation assessment.

- **[5 Tips for a Low-Stress Assessment](https://blog.helmerinc.com/5-tips-for-a-low-stress-assessment)** (Helmer Scientific, equipment vendor; vendor content) — short, practical preparation tips from a blood-bank equipment maker. Read it as a friendly checklist, not as AABB guidance. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
- **[CISSP Domain 6: Security Assessment & Testing Guide](https://destcert.com/resources/cissp-domain-6-security-assessment-and-testing/)** (Destination Certification, CISSP training company; commercial) — explains internal, external and third-party assessment strategies, a helpful parallel for how an outside assessor differs from an inspector. Supports CISSP Domain 6 (Security Assessment and Testing). Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
- **[Blood Bank Guy Essentials Podcast](https://www.bbguy.org/podcast/)** (Blood Bank Guy, Joe Chaffin, MD) — an episode index from a well-known transfusion-medicine educator; browse for quality-system and regulatory episodes to round out the assessor's-eye view. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).
